method: Both sites loaded at the same viewport and scrolled to the same offsets (one frame per viewport height, original's page height). Frames compared at 360px wide; a pixel matches when every channel is within 24/255. Route score = mean frame score x min/max page height. Section score = mean of the frames whose viewport centre falls inside the original section.
